page.overview:
Who is Auggie James?

is a young newsie and street kid recruited into Candela Obscura. He is played by Ashley Johnson.

Auggie is 19 years old, and wears cast-off clothing that doesn't really fit. His hair is mussed and his freckled face is dirty.

Auggie was described as "scrappy". He seems curious and eager to learn, as well as friendly and feisty.

Auggie was an orphan dropped off in infancy at Saint Mannigan's Lodging House for Children. He spent his entire life both there and on the streets, surviving on odd jobs. Charlotte Eaves frequently gave him shelter and odd jobs at her bar The Sight Unseen and felt protective toward him.
